title: Count a partial matrix row through three signed affine masses
statement: After t fixed Y rows span A of rank alpha, quotient by A with multiplicity q^[alpha(d-t)+p(t-alpha)]. For the next partial row only rank updates(ell,rho),(ell+1,rho),(ell+1,rho+1) occur. Three nested-space signed affine masses replace enumeration of all prefix frequencies.

assumptions: Surviving frequency rows annihilate the completed-row span
Signed character coefficients are not probabilities
costs: 2^c times polynomial bit work; elimination computes each nested-space signed mass
